examples.en: Today, as urban population explodes globally, cities become more crowded.
examples.zh: 今天，随着全球城市人口激增，城市变得更加拥挤。

examples.en: They also donated space for 3.1 million pounds of charitable shipping globally.
examples.zh: 他们还为全球价值310万英镑的公益运输提供了场地。

examples.en: You can get a globally optimal solution from locally optimal solutions to sub-problems.
examples.zh: 你可以通过子问题的局部最优方案从而得到全局优化解决方案。
